summary: Amended the plan so --force overwrites only scaffold templates while .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json always safe-merge and preserve unrelated entries.
The plan now explicitly creates a ralph-overview Copilot mirror generator in US-001 and uses it for the US-004 mirror parity gate instead of assuming an existing generator.
Amended the plan to split upsert fields into task-object fields and top-level map fields, return edited byte ranges, and assert byte identity outside the union of those ranges.
Expanded US-003/US-005 scope, files-to-modify, risk notes, and AC12 to cover exact 19-tool assertions, build test drift, and documented MCP tool-count references.
Added missing declaration-file requirements for the new script modules and a strict TypeScript build acceptance criterion.
Enumerated the exact task-object and top-level map field whitelists for overview.upsert_task and resolved the schema open question as strict with no extras escape hatch in v1.
Updated the plan to keep the package bin and print-only installer contract while using the shared server-only init path.
Added explicit serverOnly support to the overview.init API description and extended the cross-surface parity acceptance criterion to cover registration-only mode.
Added CLI --json mode to the plan and amended AC9 to require JSON parity of filesPlanned, filesSkipped, and errors across direct engine, MCP, and CLI dry-run surfaces.

Split AC6 into update and create acceptance criteria, adding create-task coverage for tasks[] append, required fields, workstream/sizeBucket map entries, formatting preservation, idempotency, and byte-identity boundaries.

Resolved the install-server contradiction by specifying the preserved wrapper/bin behavior, `initConsumer({ serverOnly: true, force: true })`, dispatcher equivalence to `init --server-only --force`, and removing the install-server open question.
